---

**Diversity and differentiation statistics for the *A. flavipes* + *B. terretsris* + *L. malachurum* RADseq datasets using the `snpR` package**

Two datasets were analyzed: the *Full Dataset* containing all SNPs, and the *Neutral Dataset*, where SNPs under the putative effect of selection were removed (based on BayPass v.3 results).  

Figures and tables in `png` format [here](2_results/).

---

# Setup 

## Install and load packages

```{r}
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("hemstrow/snpR")

devtools::install_github("vmikk/metagMisc")

library(devtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(vcfR)
library(snpR)
library(ade4)
library(plotly)
library(gt)
library(metagMisc)
```

## Source functions

```{r}
source("calc_snpR_gendiv.R")
```

# **ANDRENA FLAVIPES**

# Read and format input data

## Read VCF datasets with package `vcfR`

```{r}
# Full dataset
AND_full_vcf <-
  read.vcfR(
    "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/01_snpcall/04_BCFtools/AND_stk_rm_assafora_minDP5_minGQ30_bi_mac02_meanDP10-100_maxmiss20_thinned300bp.vcf.gz"
  )

# Neutral dataset
#qro_qil_neutral_vcf <-
  #read.vcfR(
    #"0_input/QRO_ipr_v2_2_mm80_minmaxdp10100_bi_center_putative_neutral_SNPs.vcf.gz"
  #)
```

## Input the metadata file

```{r}
# read CSV with metadata
AND_metadata <- read_csv("/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/2_metadata/02_SSF_samples/00_sampling_metadata/AND_metadata_complete.csv") %>%
  rename(
    Sample = sample,
    Landscape_Level_1 = landscape_level_1,
    Landscape_Level_2 = landscape_level_2,
    SamplingLocation = location,
    Latitude = LAT,
    Longitude = LONG
  )

# calculate mean coordinates for each sampling location
AND_coords_summary <- AND_metadata %>%
  group_by(SamplingLocation) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanLatitude = mean(Latitude),
    MeanLongitude = mean(Longitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# join mean coordinates back to main data
AND_metadata <- AND_metadata %>%
  left_join(AND_coords_summary, by = "SamplingLocation")  %>%
  select(Sample, Landscape_Level_1, Landscape_Level_2, SamplingLocation, MeanLatitude, MeanLongitude)  %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r}
#| echo: False
rmarkdown::paged_table(AND_metadata)
```

## Convert datasets from `vcfR` to `snpR` 

Use the function `snpR::convert_vcfR`, adding the genetic population information

```{r}
# Full dataset
AND_full_snpR <-
  convert_vcfR(
    AND_full_vcf,
    sample.meta = AND_metadata
  )

# Neutral dataset
qro_qil_neutral_snpR <-
  convert_vcfR(
    qro_qil_neutral_vcf,
    sample.meta = popfile
  )
```

# Analyze Results

## Genetic Diversity

Retrieve genetic diversity statistics.

```{r}
#| cache-lazy: false
AND_full_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    AND_full_snpR,
    facets = c("Landscape_Level_1",  "Landscape_Level_2", "SamplingLocation"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "hwe", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )

```

```{r}
qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    qro_qil_neutral_snpR,
    facets = c("GeneticPopulation", "SamplingLocation", "Species"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "hwe", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )
```

Genetic diversity statistics for both datasets are represented in the following tables:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Landscape_Level_1

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
AND_gendiv_genpop_gt <- 
  bind_rows(
    AND_full_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means %>%
      filter(facet == "Landscape_Level_1")
      #mutate(dataset = "Full Dataset"),
    #qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means |>
      #filter(facet == "GeneticPopulation") |>
      #mutate(dataset = "Neutral Dataset")
    )  %>%
  select(-facet, -snp.facet, -snp.subfacet, -seg_sites_var)  %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ c(
      "subfacet", "Ho", "He", "Pi", "Seg. Sites", "Priv. Alleles", "Hs",
      "Prop. Poly.", "All. Richness", "Fis"
    ),
    everything()
    )  %>%
  gt(
    groupname_col = "dataset",
    rowname_col = "subfacet"
    )  %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = everything(),
    decimals = 3
    )  %>%
  tab_style(
    cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
    )  %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("Genetic Diversity Statistics - *Genetic Population*")
    )  %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Table shows wheighted mean values of Ho, He, Pi, Hs, Allelic Richness and Fis."
    )

AND_gendiv_genpop_gt

gtsave(AND_gendiv_genpop_gt, "01_results/AND/AND_gendiv_genpop_table_SSF_LoA.docx")
```

# TESTE INPUT ALELOS PRIVADOS

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

extract_private_snps_with_both_AF <- function(vcf,
                                              metadata,
                                              group_col,
                                              sample_col = "Sample",
                                              min_called = 5,
                                              min_alt_count = 2) {

  # Match samples
  vcf_samples <- colnames(vcf@gt)[-1]
  meta <- metadata %>%
    select(all_of(sample_col), all_of(group_col)) %>%
    filter(.data[[sample_col]] %in% vcf_samples)

  fix <- as.data.frame(vcf@fix, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(
      SNP = paste0(CHROM, ":", POS),
      CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT
    )

  # Extract genotypes
  GT <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT", as.numeric = FALSE)
  GT <- GT[, meta[[sample_col]], drop = FALSE]

  # Convert to ALT count
  gt_to_altcount <- function(x) {
    x <- sub(":.*$", "", x)
    x[x %in% c(".", "./.", ".|.")] <- NA
    out <- rep(NA_integer_, length(x))
    out[x %in% c("0/0","0|0")] <- 0L
    out[x %in% c("0/1","1/0","0|1","1|0")] <- 1L
    out[x %in% c("1/1","1|1")] <- 2L
    out
  }

  alt_mat <- apply(GT, 2, gt_to_altcount)
  alt_mat <- as.matrix(alt_mat)
  rownames(alt_mat) <- fix$SNP

  group_samples <- split(meta[[sample_col]], meta[[group_col]])
  groups <- names(group_samples)

  # Calculate AF per group
  af_list <- list()
  alt_sum_list <- list()

  for (g in groups) {
    mat_g <- alt_mat[, group_samples[[g]], drop = FALSE]
    n_called <- rowSums(!is.na(mat_g))
    alt_sum  <- rowSums(mat_g, na.rm = TRUE)
    af_alt   <- ifelse(n_called > 0, alt_sum / (2 * n_called), NA_real_)

    af_list[[g]] <- af_alt
    alt_sum_list[[g]] <- alt_sum
  }

  # Identify private ALT SNPs
  private_df <- list()

  for (g in groups) {
    other_g <- setdiff(groups, g)

    idx <- which(
      alt_sum_list[[g]] >= min_alt_count &
      rowSums(sapply(other_g, function(o) alt_sum_list[[o]])) == 0
    )

    if (length(idx) > 0) {
      private_df[[g]] <- data.frame(
        SNP = names(af_list[[g]])[idx],
        private_in = g,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  private_df <- bind_rows(private_df)

  # Build AF table for both groups
  af_table <- data.frame(
    SNP = rownames(alt_mat),
    AF_LoA = af_list[["LoA"]],
    AF_SSF = af_list[["SSF"]]
  )

  # Merge
  final_table <- private_df %>%
    left_join(af_table, by = "SNP") %>%
    left_join(fix, by = "SNP")

  return(final_table)
}

AND_private_compare <- extract_private_snps_with_both_AF(
  vcf = AND_full_vcf,
  metadata = AND_metadata,
  group_col = "Landscape_Level_1",
  sample_col = "Sample",
  min_called = 5,
  min_alt_count = 2
)

head(AND_private_compare)

#write.csv(
 #AND_private_compare,
  #"01_results/AND/AND_private_SNPs_with_AF_LoA_vs_SSF.csv",
  #row.names = FALSE
#)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

AND_private_compare2 <- AND_private_compare %>%
  mutate(
    AF_private = ifelse(private_in == "LoA", AF_LoA, AF_SSF)
  )

# Histogram (per group)
ggplot(AND_private_compare2, aes(x = AF_private)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  facet_wrap(~private_in, scales = "free_y") +
  xlab("Private allele frequency (within private group)") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Density (per group)
ggplot(AND_private_compare2, aes(x = AF_private, fill = private_in)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  xlab("Private allele frequency (within private group)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(AND_private_compare2, aes(x = AF_private, colour = private_in)) +
  geom_density() +
  xlab("Private allele frequency (within private group)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# AND_private_compare is your table with SNP, private_in, AF_LoA, AF_SSF

af_long <- AND_private_compare %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AF_LoA, AF_SSF),
    names_to = "landscape",
    values_to = "AF"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    landscape = recode(landscape, AF_LoA = "LoA", AF_SSF = "SSF")
  )

top_n <- 20

top_snps <- AND_private_compare %>%
  mutate(AF_private = ifelse(private_in == "LoA", AF_LoA, AF_SSF)) %>%
  arrange(desc(AF_private)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  pull(SNP)

af_long_top <- af_long %>% filter(SNP %in% top_snps)

ggplot(af_long_top, aes(x = reorder(SNP, AF, FUN = max), y = AF, fill = landscape)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "SNP",
    y = "Allele frequency (ALT)",
    fill = "Landscape"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}
library(scales)

top_n <- 50

# 1) Pick top 50 private SNPs within each group (by AF in the private group)
top_snps_each <- AND_private_compare %>%
  mutate(AF_private = ifelse(private_in == "LoA", AF_LoA, AF_SSF)) %>%
  group_by(private_in) %>%
  slice_max(AF_private, n = top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(SNP, private_in)

# 2) Build long table with both AFs, keep private_in, and order SNPs by CHR and POS within each panel
af_long_top <- AND_private_compare %>%
  inner_join(top_snps_each, by = c("SNP", "private_in")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(AF_LoA, AF_SSF),
    names_to = "landscape",
    values_to = "AF"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    landscape = recode(landscape, AF_LoA = "LoA", AF_SSF = "SSF"),
    chr_num = as.numeric(str_remove(str_extract(SNP, "CHR[0-9]+"), "CHR")),
    pos_num = as.numeric(str_extract(SNP, "(?<=:)[0-9]+"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(private_in, chr_num, pos_num) %>%
  group_by(private_in) %>%
  mutate(SNP_ord = factor(SNP, levels = unique(SNP))) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) Plot: two panels, top 50 each, more specific y scale
ggplot(af_long_top, aes(x = SNP_ord, y = AF, fill = landscape)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.85) +
  facet_wrap(~private_in, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "SNP (ordered by chromosome and position)",
    y = "Allele frequency (ALT)",
    fill = "Landscape"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

# Read and format input data

## Read VCF datasets with package `vcfR`

```{r}
# Full dataset
BOM_full_vcf <-
  read.vcfR(
    "/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/01_snpcall/04_BCFtools/BOM_stk_rm_kinship_assafora_minDP5_minGQ30_bi_mac02_meanDP10-100_maxmiss20_thinned300bp.vcf.gz"
  )

# Neutral dataset
qro_qil_neutral_vcf <-
  read.vcfR(
    "0_input/QRO_ipr_v2_2_mm80_minmaxdp10100_bi_center_putative_neutral_SNPs.vcf.gz"
  )
```

## Input the metadata file

```{r}
# read CSV with metadata
BOM_metadata <- read_csv("/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/2_metadata/02_SSF_samples/00_sampling_metadata/BOM_metadata_complete.csv") %>%
  rename(
    Sample = sample,
    Landscape_Level_1 = landscape_level_1,
    Landscape_Level_2 = landscape_level_2,
    SamplingLocation = location,
    Latitude = LAT,
    Longitude = LONG
  )

# calculate mean coordinates for each sampling location
BOM_coords_summary <- BOM_metadata %>%
  group_by(SamplingLocation) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanLatitude = mean(Latitude),
    MeanLongitude = mean(Longitude),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# join mean coordinates back to main data
BOM_metadata <- BOM_metadata %>%
  left_join(BOM_coords_summary, by = "SamplingLocation")  %>%
  select(Sample, Landscape_Level_1, Landscape_Level_2, SamplingLocation, MeanLatitude, MeanLongitude)  %>%
  distinct()
```

## Genetic Diversity

Retrieve genetic diversity statistics.

```{r}
#| cache-lazy: false
BOM_full_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    BOM_full_snpR,
    facets = c("Landscape_Level_1",  "Landscape_Level_2", "SamplingLocation"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    qro_qil_neutral_snpR,
    facets = c("GeneticPopulation", "SamplingLocation", "Species"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "hwe", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )
```

Genetic diversity statistics for both datasets are represented in the following tables:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Landscape_Level_1

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
BOM_gendiv_genpop_gt <- 
  bind_rows(
    BOM_full_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means %>%
      filter(facet == "Landscape_Level_1")
      #mutate(dataset = "Full Dataset"),
    #qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means |>
      #filter(facet == "GeneticPopulation") |>
      #mutate(dataset = "Neutral Dataset")
    )  %>%
  select(-facet, -snp.facet, -snp.subfacet, -seg_sites_var)  %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ c(
      "subfacet", "Ho", "He", "Pi", "Seg. Sites", "Priv. Alleles", "Hs",
      "Prop. Poly.", "All. Richness", "Fis"
    ),
    everything()
    )  %>%
  gt(
    groupname_col = "dataset",
    rowname_col = "subfacet"
    )  %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = everything(),
    decimals = 3
    )  %>%
  tab_style(
    cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
    )  %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("Genetic Diversity Statistics - *Landscape_Level_1*")
    )  %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Table shows wheighted mean values of Ho, He, Pi, Hs, Allelic Richness and Fis."
    )

BOM_gendiv_genpop_gt

gtsave(BOM_gendiv_genpop_gt, "01_results/BOM/BOM_gendiv_genpop_table_SSF_LoA.docx")
```

```{r}
    facets = "SamplingLocation",
```
```{r}
    nrepet = 9999
```
```{r}
  )
```

# Analyze Results

## Genetic Diversity

Retrieve genetic diversity statistics.

```{r}
#| cache-lazy: false
LGL_full_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    LGL_full_snpR,
    facets = c("Landscape_Level_1",  "Landscape_Level_2", "SamplingLocation"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv <-
  get.snpR.stats(
    qro_qil_neutral_snpR,
    facets = c("GeneticPopulation", "SamplingLocation", "Species"),
    stats = c(
      "ho", "he", "hwe", "pi", "private", "seg_sites", "prop_poly", "hs",
      "allelic_richness", "fis"
    )
  )
```

Genetic diversity statistics for both datasets are represented in the following tables:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Landscape_Level_1

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
LGL_gendiv_genpop_gt <- 
  bind_rows(
    LGL_full_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means %>%
      filter(facet == "Landscape_Level_1")
      #mutate(dataset = "Full Dataset"),
    #qro_qil_neutral_snpR_gendiv$weighted.means |>
      #filter(facet == "GeneticPopulation") |>
      #mutate(dataset = "Neutral Dataset")
    )  %>%
  select(-facet, -snp.facet, -snp.subfacet, -seg_sites_var)  %>%
  rename_with(
    ~ c(
      "subfacet", "Ho", "He", "Pi", "Seg. Sites", "Priv. Alleles", "Hs",
      "Prop. Poly.", "All. Richness", "Fis"
    ),
    everything()
    )  %>%
  gt(
    groupname_col = "dataset",
    rowname_col = "subfacet"
    )  %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = everything(),
    decimals = 3
    )  %>%
  tab_style(
    cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
    )  %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("Genetic Diversity Statistics - *Landscape_Level_1*")
    )  %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Table shows wheighted mean values of Ho, He, Pi, Hs, Allelic Richness and Fis."
    )

LGL_gendiv_genpop_gt

gtsave(LGL_gendiv_genpop_gt, "01_results/LGL/LGL_gendiv_genpop_table_SSF_LoA.docx")
```

## Isolation by Distance

### Extract IBD results

```{r}
#| cache-lazy: false
LGL_full_IBD <- 
  get.snpR.stats(
  LGL_full_snpR,
  "SamplingLocation",
  "ibd"
  )
  
qro_qil_neutral_IBD <- 
  get.snpR.stats(
  qro_qil_neutral_snpR,
  "SamplingLocation",
  "ibd"
  )
```

### Check Mantel Test results

```{r}
# Full Dataset
LGL_full_IBD
plot(LGL_full_IBD[["SamplingLocation"]][[".base"]][["Edwards"]])
  
# Neutral Dataset  
qro_qil_neutral_IBD
plot(qro_qil_neutral_IBD[["SamplingLocation"]][[".base"]][["Edwards"]])
```

```{r}
    facets = "SamplingLocation",
    stats = "genetic_distance"
  )
```

```{r}
LGL_full_GEO <-
```

### Plot Genetic x Geographical Distance

```{r}
  #| code-fold: true

mantel_r <- -0.2306
mantel_p <- 0.7949

mantel_label <- paste0(
  "Mantel r = ", mantel_r, "\n",
  "p = ", mantel_p
)

p_ibd <- left_join(
  metagMisc::dist2list(LGL_full_GD$SamplingLocation$.base$Edwards),
  metagMisc::dist2list(LGL_full_GEO$SamplingLocation$Edwards),
  by = c("col", "row"),
  suffix = c(".GD", ".GEO")
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value.GEO, y = value.GD)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  xlab("Geographical Distance") +
  ylab("Genetic Distance (Edwards)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = mantel_label,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2,
    size = 4
  )

ggsave("01_results/LGL/LGL_ibd_full_dataset.png", bg = "white")
  
left_join(
  metagMisc::dist2list(qro_qil_neutral_GD$SamplingLocation$.base$Edwards),
  metagMisc::dist2list(qro_qil_neutral_GEO$SamplingLocation$Edwards),
  by = c("col", "row"), 
  suffix = c(".GD", ".GEO") 
  ) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = value.GEO, y = value.GD)
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  xlab("Geographical Distance") +
  ylab("Genetic Distance (Edwards)") +
  #ggtitle("Isolation by Distance - Neutral Dataset") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("2_results/qro_qil_ibd_neutral_dataset.png", bg = "white")
```
